Name: (AT) Minecraft Scarecrow
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Have you seen [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/186152427]Rwuaaaaa's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25897]Minecraft Scarecrow[/url] mod for CP and wished it was an AT pack for your farm? Well wish no longer, for here it is, converted for use with the fabulous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod! All credit, of course, is given to Rwuaaaaa for the actual scarecrow textures, I just converted their mod, with their permission, for use with AT!


[b]Installation:[/b]
[b]1.[/b] Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2.[/b] Unzip the '[AT] Minecraft Scarecrows' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3.[/b] Buy the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url] tool from Robin, to use on your items and retexture them.
[b]4.[/b] Congrats, you're done and ready to retexture! Enjoy your new furniture!
